text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day after school, while walking through the school building—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... Yet another victory.
You really are amazing, Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Ngh, so frustrating~! I really wanted to snap that undefeated streak~!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hahaha~, who's my next opponent, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Sei-chan
is completely undefeated in card games, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It was such a captivating race with mind games at play,
even I found myself utterly engrossed in it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then how about I take on the next challenger?
Just to kill some time until dinner~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I got beaten in seconds...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, want a rematch?
Sei-chan is always down~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In that case, I will support you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Sei-chan on her winning streak,
I've come to understand her racing habits as well."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Even in the games I've played, the support character was always the catalyst for victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Two against one, sounds good to me~.
Feels like it'll be a real challenge.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then, let us settle this fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
first, slash in with that hand and see how the opponent reacts—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty~.
I totally knew you'd slash straight in like that♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I put up a much better fight than in my debut race, but I still fell just one step short.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that gave me chills too~
Both of you are seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I managed to kill some time, so I'll be heading off to dinner soon—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
............
......One more round, please~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We have enough time for a match before dinner, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us get started right away.
We have no time to slack off~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"You've drawn a great hand.
Now let's use it right away to throw our opponent off balance."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're playing that card now?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Because—you have no follow-up move, do you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The enemy has no defense prepared. Activating trap via Scheme Card.
Lock down their movement and strike without giving them an opening."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-san, don't be shy.
Just keep playing your cards~.
choice_data_list: As expected, that was top-tier support.
As expected, that was top-tier support.
You call that support? That felt more like an attack...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-san, don't be shy.
Just keep playing your cards~.
choice_data_list: As expected, that was top-tier support.
As expected, that was top-tier support.
You call that support? That felt more like an attack...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "I'm honored to hear you say that. I will continue to support you in my own way."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Aiming for a happy ending♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~... Talk about poking a hornet's nest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, the two of them coordinated their offense and defense in perfect sync,
pulling off a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just support, you know?
Think of it as being a strategist~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, our opponent has no moves left.
If this keeps up, it'll be our turn indefinitely.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Let's launch an aggressive assault and keep piling on the pressure.
Without resting a moment♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Continuing with relentless attacks after that, she clinched a splendid victory...!
